name: Armature
description: The armature under a figure: a spine, a crossbar and two legs.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M50 8 V56 M18 30 H82 M50 56 L24 92 M50 56 L76 92; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 8; stroke-linecap: round; }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M50 8 V56 M18 30 H82 M50 56 L24 92 M50 56 L76 92; fill: none; stroke: #000; stroke-width: 8; stroke-linecap: round; }); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
